all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ بَشِيرࣰ ا وَنَذِيرࣰ اۖ وَلَا تُسۡـَٔلُ عَنۡ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

translations.saheeh: Indeed, We have sent you, [O Muhammad], with the truth as a bringer of good tidings and a warner, and you will not be asked about the companions of Hellfire.
translations.pickthall: Lo! We have sent thee (O Muhammad) with the truth, a bringer of glad tidings and a warner. And thou wilt not be asked about the owners of hell-fire.
translations.khattab: We have surely sent you with the truth ˹O Prophet˺ as a deliverer of good news and a warner. And you will not be accountable for the residents of the Hellfire
translations.arberry: We have sent thee with the truth, good tidings to bear, and warning. Thou shalt not be questioned touching the inhabitants of Hell.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

translations.saheeh: But those who disbelieve and deny Our signs - those are the companions of Hellfire.
translations.pickthall: And they who disbelieve and deny Our revelations, such are rightful owners of hell.
translations.khattab: As for those who disbelieve and deny Our signs, they are the residents of the Hellfire
translations.arberry: And the unbelievers, who cried lies to Our signs -- they shall be the inhabitants of Hell.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

translations.saheeh: But those who disbelieved and denied Our signs - they are the companions of Hellfire.
translations.pickthall: But those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations, they are owners of hell-fire.
translations.khattab: As for those who disbelieve and reject Our signs, they will be the residents of the Hellfire
translations.arberry: But those who disbelieve, and cry lies to Our signs -- they are the inhabitants of Hell.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: مَا كَانَ لِلنَّبِيِّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَن يَسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ لِلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ وَلَوۡ كَانُوٓاْ أُوْلِي قُرۡبَىٰ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمۡ أَنَّهُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

translations.saheeh: It is not for the Prophet and those who have believed to ask forgiveness for the polytheists, even if they were relatives, after it has become clear to them that they are companions of Hellfire.
translations.pickthall: It is not for the Prophet, and those who believe, to pray for the forgiveness of idolaters even though they may be near of kin (to them) after it hath become clear that they are people of hell-fire.
translations.khattab: It is not ˹proper˺ for the Prophet and the believers to seek forgiveness for the polytheists, even if they were close relatives, after it has become clear to the believers that they are bound for the Hellfire
translations.arberry: It is not for the Prophet and the believers to ask pardon for the idolaters, even though they be near kinsmen, after that it has become clear to them that they will be the inhabitants of Hell.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ سَعَوۡاْ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مُعَٰجِزِينَ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

translations.saheeh: But the ones who strove against Our verses, [seeking] to cause failure - those are the companions of Hellfire.
translations.pickthall: While those who strive to thwart Our revelations, such are rightful owners of the Fire.
translations.khattab: But those who strive to discredit Our revelations, they will be the residents of the Hellfire.”
translations.arberry: And those who strive against Our signs to void them -- they shall be the inhabitants of Hell.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلۡجَحِيمُ لِلۡغَاوِينَ

translations.saheeh: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,
translations.pickthall: And hell will appear plainly to the erring.
translations.khattab: and the Hellfire will be displayed to the deviant
translations.arberry: and Hell advanced for the perverse.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهۡدُوهُمۡ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

translations.saheeh: Other than Allah, and guide them to the path of Hellfire
translations.pickthall: Instead of Allah, and lead them to the path to hell;
translations.khattab: instead of Allah, then lead them ˹all˺ to the path of Hell
translations.arberry: apart from God, and guide them unto the path of Hell!

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِي سَوَآءِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

translations.saheeh: And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire.
translations.pickthall: Then looketh he and seeth him in the depth of hell.
translations.khattab: Then he ˹and the others˺ will look and spot him in the midst of the Hellfire
translations.arberry: Then he looks, and sees him in the midst of Hell.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةࣱ تَخۡرُجُ فِيٓ أَصۡلِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

translations.saheeh: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,
translations.pickthall: Lo! it is a tree that springeth in the heart of hell.
translations.khattab: Indeed, it is a tree that grows in the depths of Hell
translations.arberry: It is a tree that comes forth in the root of Hell;

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرۡجِعَهُمۡ لَإِلَى ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

translations.saheeh: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.
translations.pickthall: And afterward, lo! their return is surely unto hell.
translations.khattab: Then they will ultimately return to ˹their place in˺ Hell
translations.arberry: then their return is unto Hell.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ ٱبۡنُواْ لَهُۥ بُنۡيَٰنࣰ ا فَأَلۡقُوهُ فِي ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

translations.saheeh: They said, "Construct for him a furnace and throw him into the burning fire."
translations.pickthall: They said: Build for him a building and fling him in the red-hotfire.
translations.khattab: They said ˹to one another˺, “Build him a furnace and cast him into the blazing fire.”
translations.arberry: They said, 'Build him a building, and cast him into the furnace!'

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِلَّا مَنۡ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

translations.saheeh: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire.
translations.pickthall: Save him who is to burn in hell.
translations.khattab: except those ˹destined˺ to burn in Hell
translations.arberry: except him who shall roast in Hell.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَحۡمِلُونَ ٱلۡعَرۡشَ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهُۥ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَيُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَيَسۡتَغۡفِرُونَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْۖ رَبَّنَا وَسِعۡتَ كُلَّ شَيۡءࣲ رَّحۡمَةࣰ وَعِلۡمࣰ ا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُواْ وَٱتَّبَعُواْ سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

translations.saheeh: Those [angels] who carry the Throne and those around it exalt [Allah] with praise of their Lord and believe in Him and ask forgiveness for those who have believed, [saying], "Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire.
translations.pickthall: Those who bear the Throne, and all who are round about it, hymn the praises of their Lord and believe in Him and ask forgiveness for those who believe (saying): Our Lord! Thou comprehendest all things in mercy and knowledge, therefor forgive those who repent and follow Thy way. Ward off from them the punishment of hell.
translations.khattab: Those ˹angels˺ who carry the Throne and those around it glorify the praises of their Lord, have faith in Him, and seek forgiveness for the believers, ˹praying:˺ “Our Lord! You encompass everything in ˹Your˺ mercy and knowledge. So forgive those who repent and follow Your Way, and protect them from the torment of the Hellfire
translations.arberry: Those who bear the Throne, and those round about it proclaim the praise of their Lord, and believe in Him, and they ask forgiveness for those who believe: 'Our Lord, Thou embracest every thing in mercy and knowledge; therefore forgive those who have repented, and follow Thy way, and guard them against the chastisement of Hell.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: خُذُوهُ فَٱعۡتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

translations.saheeh: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,
translations.pickthall: (And it will be said): Take him and drag him to the midst of hell,
translations.khattab: ˹It will be said,˺ “Seize them and drag them into the depths of the Hellfire
translations.arberry: 'Take him, and thrust him into the midst of Hell,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلۡمَوۡتَ إِلَّا ٱلۡمَوۡتَةَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

translations.saheeh: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire
translations.pickthall: They taste not death therein, save the first death. And He hath saved them from the doom of hell,
translations.khattab: There they will never taste death, beyond the first death. And He will protect them from the punishment of the Hellfire—
translations.arberry: They shall not taste therein of death, save the first death, And He shall guard them against the chastisement of Hell --

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

translations.saheeh: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.
translations.pickthall: Happy because of what their Lord hath given them, and (because) their Lord hath warded off from them the torment of hell-fire.
translations.khattab: enjoying whatever their Lord will have granted them. And their Lord will have protected them from the torment of the Hellfire
translations.arberry: rejoicing in that their Lord has given them; and their Lord shall guard them against the chastisement of Hell.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَتَصۡلِيَةُ جَحِيمٍ

translations.saheeh: And burning in Hellfire
translations.pickthall: And roasting at hell-fire.
translations.khattab: and burning in Hellfire
translations.arberry: and the roasting in Hell.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦٓ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَۖ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءُ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرُهُمۡ وَنُورُهُمۡۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

translations.saheeh: And those who have believed in Allah and His messengers - those are [in the ranks of] the supporters of truth and the martyrs, with their Lord. For them is their reward and their light. But those who have disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of Hellfire.
translations.pickthall: And those who believe in Allah and His messengers, they are the loyal, and the martyrs are with their Lord; they have their reward and their light; while as for those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations, they are owners of hell-fire.
translations.khattab: ˹As for˺ those who believe in Allah and His messengers, it is they who are ˹truly˺ the people of truth. And the martyrs, with their Lord, will have their reward and their light. But ˹as for˺ those who disbelieve and reject Our signs, it is they who will be the residents of the Hellfire
translations.arberry: And those who believe in God and His Messengers -- they are the just men and the martyrs in their Lord's sight; they have their wage, and their light. But the unbelievers, who have cried lies to Our signs, they are the inhabitants of Hell.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ ٱلۡجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ

translations.saheeh: Then into Hellfire drive him.
translations.pickthall: And then expose him to hell-fire
translations.khattab: then burn them in Hell
translations.arberry: and then roast him in Hell,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ لَدَيۡنَآ أَنكَالࣰ ا وَجَحِيمࣰ ا

translations.saheeh: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire
translations.pickthall: Lo! with Us are heavy fetters and a raging fire,
translations.khattab: ˹For˺ We certainly have shackles, a ˹raging˺ Fire
translations.arberry: for with Us there are fetters, and a furnace,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلۡجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ

translations.saheeh: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -
translations.pickthall: And hell will stand forth visible to him who seeth,
translations.khattab: and the Hellfire will be displayed for all to see—
translations.arberry: and Hell is advanced for whoever sees,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلۡجَحِيمَ هِيَ ٱلۡمَأۡوَىٰ

translations.saheeh: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.
translations.pickthall: Lo! hell will be his home.
translations.khattab: the Hellfire will certainly be ˹their˺ home
translations.arberry: surely Hell shall be the refuge.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتۡ

translations.saheeh: And when Hellfire is set ablaze
translations.pickthall: And when hell is lighted,
translations.khattab: and when the Hellfire is fiercely flared up
translations.arberry: when Hell shall be set blazing,

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلۡفُجَّارَ لَفِي جَحِيمࣲ‏

translations.saheeh: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.
translations.pickthall: And lo! the wicked verily will be in hell;
translations.khattab: and the wicked will be in Hell
translations.arberry: and the libertines shall be in a fiery furnace

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمۡ لَصَالُواْ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ

translations.saheeh: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.
translations.pickthall: Then lo! they verily will burn in hell,
translations.khattab: Moreover, they will surely burn in Hell
translations.arberry: then they shall roast in Hell.

all_occurrences.ayah_arabic: لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلۡجَحِيمَ

translations.saheeh: You will surely see the Hellfire.
translations.pickthall: For ye will behold hell-fire.
translations.khattab: ˹But˺ you will surely see the Hellfire
translations.arberry: you shall surely see Hell;
